lines.en: label nikispring4:
scene black
Some nights I dream of things my brother tells me to ignore.
lines.zh: 有些夜里，我会梦见哥哥叫我别去理会的事。

lines.en: But in my sleep I can’t control the grip of her allure.
lines.zh: 但在睡梦中，我无法抵挡她那魅力对我的钳制。

lines.en: The way she combs my hair; how she moves across the floor.
lines.zh: 她梳理我头发的方式；她穿过地板的姿态。

lines.en: There will always be a limit to how much I can endure.
lines.zh: 我能忍受的，永远有个上限。

lines.en: {s}You kissed me after this one.{/s}
lines.zh: {s}这一段之后，你吻了我。{/s}

lines.en: scene nikipretrip1
: {i}KYAAAAAAAH! Onii-chan’s sleeping face!{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}呀啊啊啊啊！哥的睡颜！{/i}

lines.en: : Onee-chan...you seriously mean to tell me you get to wake up to this every day of the week?
lines.zh: : Onee-chan……你是认真要告诉我，你每天都能被这张脸叫醒吗？

lines.en: : You’re just lucky he’s wearing clothes this time.
lines.zh: : 你该庆幸这次他穿着衣服。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip2
: Am I {i}really,{/i} though? Like...would it really be {i}so{/i} bad if, as both his sister and sort of his sister {i}in-law,{/i} for me to just...accidentally see his penis in the morning?
lines.zh: : 可我{i}真的{/i}幸运吗？就是说……作为他的妹妹、又算是他的{i}小姨子{/i}，我早上……不小心看见他的鸡巴，真的{i}很{/i}糟糕吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: : Not even with your permission?
lines.zh: : 就算你同意也不行？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip3
: Why would I give you my permission, you fucking psychopath?!
lines.zh: : 我凭什么同意，你这个该死的变态？！

lines.en: : Because you love me!
lines.zh: : 因为你爱我！

lines.en: : Not {i}that{/i} much! Find your own penis! I mean...boyfriend!
lines.zh: : 没爱到{i}那{/i}份上！自己去找根鸡巴！我是说……男朋友！

lines.en: scene nikipretrip4
: But sisters are supposed to {i}share.{/i} And you {i}always{/i} give me your hand-me-downs.
lines.zh: : 可姐妹之间就该{i}分享{/i}啊。而且你{i}老是{/i}把旧东西给我。

lines.en: : I {i}wouldn’t{/i} have if Mom didn’t pressure me to.
lines.zh: : 要不是妈逼我，我才{i}不会{/i}。

lines.en: : So you’re telling me if Mom pressures you into letting me have a turn with Onii-chan-
lines.zh: : 所以你的意思是，如果妈逼你让我也轮一次 Onii-chan——

lines.en: scene nikipretrip5
: It’s not going to happen, Noriko! Now stop wanting to fuck your brother! I deal with incestual tendencies enough on a day-to-day basis! I don’t need you adding to that!
lines.zh: : 不可能的，Noriko！别再想睡你哥了！我每天光处理那些乱伦倾向就已经够受的了！不需要你再来添一笔！

lines.en: : {i}Hey, are you guys talking about incest in there?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}喂，你们在里面聊乱伦吗？{/i}

lines.en: : Great! Now look what you’ve done!
lines.zh: : 好极了！看看你干的好事！

lines.en: scene nikipretrip6
: What if you just cover his eyes for a few minutes and let me...you know...{i}sample{/i} him a little bit? Heheh...
lines.zh: : 要不你就把他的眼睛捂上几分钟，让我……那个……稍微{i}试吃{/i}他一小口？嘿嘿……

lines.en: : Akira! Get out of the fucking bed already! I know you’re awake!
lines.zh: : Akira！快给我滚下床！我知道你醒了！

lines.en: scene black
: Ugh...how did you know?
lines.zh: : 呃……你怎么知道的？

lines.en: : Because you kept opening your fucking eyes, idiot. Some backup would’ve been nice, you know.
lines.zh: : 因为你一直他妈的睁着眼，白痴。你能帮我说句话也行啊。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip7
: I’m sorry, Niki. But unlike you, I’m actually {i}kind{/i} to my little sister.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，Niki。可不像你，我对我妹妹是真的{i}好{/i}。

lines.en: : Perhaps {i}too{/i} kind if you can hear all of that and not tell her to knock it off.
lines.zh: : 好到{i}过头{/i}了吧——听了那堆话都不叫她收敛点。

lines.en: : Noriko’s her own girl and I won’t tell her how to live her life. Just one more example of me being a better sibling than you.
lines.zh: : Noriko 是独立的个体，我不会去教她怎么活。这只是又一个例子，证明我比你更称职。

lines.en: : I love you, Onii-chan!
lines.zh: : 我爱你，哥！

lines.en: : That’s nice, Noriko.
lines.zh: : 真好，Noriko。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip8
: Gah! Being rejected so early in the morning is doing unspeakable things to me! If only someone could teach me what to do with these sudden urges!
lines.zh: : 啊！一大早被拒绝，对我造成了难以言说的影响！要是有人能教教我，该怎么处理这些突如其来的冲动就好了！

lines.en: : I hate both of you. But I am pleased to announce that I won’t {i}have{/i} to for much longer as we are leaving.
lines.zh: : 我恨你们两个。不过很高兴地宣布，我{i}不用{/i}再恨太久了，因为我们要走了。

lines.en: : Oh, really? Did Ami finally convince you to move back out?
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？Ami 终于说服你搬出去了？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip9
: No, asshole! I meant I’m leaving for the weekend. And I’m taking Noriko and Ami with me. That’s why I’m waking you up so early. To say goodbye.
lines.zh: : 不，混蛋！我是说这个周末我要出门。还带着 Noriko 和 Ami。所以我才这么早叫醒你。来道别的。

lines.en: : Ahh. I thought it was kind of weird that you weren’t waking me up in the normal way.
lines.zh: : 啊。我说呢，你没用「正常方式」叫醒我，怪怪的。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip10
: What’s the normal way?
lines.zh: : 正常方式是什么？

lines.en: : Unfortunately, this means you’ll have to wake yourself up until we get back on Monday. And also cook for yourself. Which basically means you’ll wind up ordering.
lines.zh: : 不幸的是，这意味着周一我们回来之前，你得自己起床了。也得自己做饭。基本上就等于你会去点外卖。

lines.en: : That said, I left all of the menus out on the dining room table so you don’t text me a million times looking for them instead of just using DoorDash like a god damn adult.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，我把所有菜单都摊在餐桌上了，省得你给我发一百万条短信找它们，而不是像个该死的成年人一样直接用 DoorDash。

lines.en: : Onii-chan, what’s the normal way?
lines.zh: : 哥，正常方式是什么？

lines.en: : What’s with the sudden trip? And why am I not invited?
lines.zh: : 怎么突然要去？为什么不叫我一起？

lines.en: : It’s not sudden. I’ve told you about it every day this week. You’re just a fucking idiot and only retain information directly relevant to your dick.
lines.zh: : 不突然。这星期我天天跟你说。你就是个该死的白痴，只记得跟你的鸡巴直接相关的信息。

lines.en: : Well, that’s clearly not true because your absence is very relevant to my dick.
lines.zh: : 那显然不对，因为你不在这件事，跟我的鸡巴就很有关系。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip11
: Can somebody tell me what the normal way is?! I have a very understandable and rational interest in what the two of you do together!
lines.zh: : 谁能告诉我正常方式是什么？！我对你们俩一起做的事有非常合理、非常理性的兴趣！

lines.en: : Act innocent all you like, twerp. We both know you’re mature enough to have figured out what that meant immediately.
lines.zh: : 你爱装纯就装，小屁孩。我们俩都知道你已经成熟到立刻就明白那是什么意思了。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip12
: If I’m so mature, why won’t you let me sample my brother? Huh, Nee-chan? What’s the reasoning behind that?
lines.zh: : 既然我这么成熟，那你为什么不让我试吃我哥？嗯，姐？这背后是什么道理？

lines.en: : The same reason I won’t let you wear this sweater. It’s my property and I’m not done with it yet.
lines.zh: : 跟我不让你穿这件毛衣是同一个道理。它是我的财产，我还没用够呢。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip13
: Fine! Then I guess I’ll just have to be a good girl and act more like a {i}normal{/i} little sister until you {i}are!{/i}
lines.zh: : 行！那我就只能当个乖女孩，表现得更像个{i}普通{/i}的妹妹，直到你{i}用够{/i}为止！

lines.en: : That’s...yeah. That’s exactly what I want, actually. I think I just won.
lines.zh: : 这……是啊。这正是我想要的，说真的。我觉得我赢了。

lines.en: : Of course you won. You’re older. You {i}always{/i} win.
lines.zh: : 你当然赢了。你比较年长。你{i}总是{/i}赢。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip14
: That just means I get to spend more time with Onii-chan, though! And none of it will be suspicious!
lines.zh: : 不过那意味着我能跟哥待更久！而且一点都不会惹人怀疑！

lines.en: : Oh good. So exactly the way things are supposed to be.
lines.zh: : 哦，好。那正是事情该有的样子。

lines.en: : That said, your special {i}sibling time{/i} won’t begin until after our trip. Now, please excuse me while I go make sure the {i}real{/i} incest demon is packed.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，你们的「特别兄妹时间」要等我们旅行回来才开始。现在失陪一下，我去确认那个{i}真正{/i}的乱伦恶魔收拾好行李了没。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip15
: Bye, Nee-chan! This is the part where I’d normally make some kind of joke about locking the door! But I won’t do that now since I’m going full sister-mode from now on!
lines.zh: : 拜拜，姐！这里我本来该开个「锁门」之类的玩笑的！但现在我不开了，因为从现在起我要全面进入妹妹模式！

lines.en: : And how long will that last, do you think?
lines.zh: : 你觉得那能维持多久？

lines.en: : Until you get me really flustered and tell me you want to do me or something. You know. Regular little sister stuff.
lines.zh: : 直到你把我撩得面红耳赤，然后说你想跟我做点什么之类的。你知道的。普通妹妹会做的事。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip16
: Where are you guys even going? And...{i}why{/i} are you going without me? Am I not a part of this family anymore?
lines.zh: : 你们到底要去哪儿？还有……{i}为什么{/i}不带上我？我不是这个家的一分子了吗？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip17
: Of course you are, Onii-chan! And perhaps the most important part of all since you’re the only one who possesses the genetic capability to extend and grow our family.
lines.zh: : 你当然是，哥！而且大概是最重要的一分子——因为你是唯一具备基因能力，能让咱们家开枝散叶的人。

lines.en: : Yeah. That’s not really doable by myself, though.
lines.zh: : 嗯。可这事我一个人办不到啊。

lines.en: : Sure. But if you take just one of us girls away, the family can still grow. And between Nee-chan and Ami both claiming you as their property, I guess that piece is going to be me.
lines.zh: : 当然。但只要你挑走我们其中一个姑娘，这个家还是能壮大。既然姐和 Ami 都把你划归她们所有，那这一块大概就落在我头上了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well I’d prefer you don’t go anywhere either since you’re the only one of them I can confidently call {i}my{/i} property.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过我也不想你去任何地方，因为你是她们里面唯一一个我能拍胸脯说是「{i}我的{/i}」的人。

lines.en: : The feminist part of me hates that, but the brocon part of me has never been happier to hear anything. I’m so conflicted all of a sudden, Nii-chan.
lines.zh: : 我身上女权主义的那部分恨死这句话了，可兄控的那部分从没听过比这更开心的话。我突然好矛盾啊，哥。

lines.en: : Noriko. Where are you going and why?
lines.zh: : Noriko。你们要去哪儿，为什么去？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip18
: The beach. Nee-chan has a photo-shoot tomorrow and wants to try and cultivate her new, motherly bond with Ami. The inclusion of me apparently makes that easier.
lines.zh: : 海边。姐明天有拍摄，想借机培养她跟 Ami 之间那种崭新的、母亲般的羁绊。显然带上我，会让这事容易些。

lines.en: : What are you going to do then?
lines.zh: : 那你打算做什么？

lines.en: : Secretly invite you, of course.
lines.zh: : 当然是偷偷把你也叫上。

lines.en: : Oh.
: Well, that was way easier than I thought it’d be.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这比我以为的容易多了。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip19
: You can’t let either of them find out though, okay? It’s apparently harder to connect with Ami while you’re around. So you need to be removed from the picture entirely.
lines.zh: : 不过你别让她们俩任何一个发现，好吗？你在的时候，Ami 显然更难跟人交心。所以你得从画面里被彻底移除。

lines.en: : And if Nee-chan finds out I brought you, she’ll invoke Nakayama Sister Law 19A-B-42L. We do {i}not{/i} want that to happen, Onii-chan.
lines.zh: : 要是姐发现是我带你来的，她会启动《中山姐妹法》第 19A-B-42L 条。我们可{i}不{/i}想让那种事发生，哥。

lines.en: : Why? What does that law do?
lines.zh: : 为什么？那条法律是干什么的？

lines.en: : If Nakayama Sister Law 19A-B-42L is invoked, Nee-chan has the right to sacrifice me to a demon of her choice.
lines.zh: : 一旦《中山姐妹法》第 19A-B-42L 条被启动，姐就有权把我献祭给她选中的任意一个恶魔。

lines.en: : And there’s nothing I can do about it either because that’s the law and laws are meant to be followed.
lines.zh: : 而我也拿它没办法，因为那就是法律，而法律就该被遵守。

lines.en: : Aren’t you an anarchist?
lines.zh: : 你不是无政府主义者吗？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip20
: For actual laws, yeah. Sister Law, though? That’s way bigger and scarier. You think I want to be sacrificed to a demon, Nii-chan? Because I don’t.
lines.zh: : 对真正的法律，是啊。可是《姐妹法》？那可大得多、也可怕得多。你觉得我想被献祭给恶魔吗，哥？我可不想。

lines.en: : Then why not just invite Kirin instead or something if my inclusion is so dangerous for you?
lines.zh: : 那既然带上我这么危险，你为什么不干脆请 Kirin 什么的？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip21
: Because I like you better than her and want to spend more time with you since I’m pretty sure this is the largest gap in character events any of your love interests have ever had.
lines.zh: : 因为我喜欢你胜过她，也想跟你多待一会儿——毕竟我敢肯定，这是你所有恋爱对象里，角色事件间隔最长的一次了。

lines.en: : What?
lines.zh: : 什么？

lines.en: : Just a hunch. Molly’s not the only one who thinks of dating in video game terms.
lines.zh: : 只是直觉。会用电子游戏术语理解恋爱的，可不只 Molly 一个。

lines.en: : ...Is what I {i}would{/i} say if I hadn’t already pledged to engage sister-mode.
lines.zh: : ……如果我没宣誓进入妹妹模式，我本来{i}会{/i}这么说。

lines.en: : Does Nee-chan really give you a blowjob every single morning?
lines.zh: : 姐真的每天早上都给你口交吗？

lines.en: scene black
: I don’t even want one sometimes. I think she has a problem.
lines.zh: : 有时候我自己都不想要。我觉得她有点上瘾。

lines.en: : So, hypothetically, if someone were to hide a camera in here, where would you least likely check?
lines.zh: : 那么，假设有人在屋里藏了个摄像头，你最不可能去翻哪里？

lines.en: scene nikipretrip22
: Ami — you almost ready to go? We’re about to- what are you doing?
lines.zh: : Ami——你快准备好了吗？我们马上就——你在干什么？

lines.en: : Oh. Sorry, Aunt Niki. I just had to do something really quick before we leave.
lines.zh: : 哦。抱歉，Niki 阿姨。我出发前得赶紧做点事。

lines.en: : Is that “something” increasing the amount of fanservice we have in this game? Because there’s really no other reason for you to be standing like that.
lines.zh: : 那件「事」是给这款游戏增加福利镜头吗？因为实在没有别的理由能让你那样站着。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip23
: Fanservice? Whatever do you mean? This is just how I stand when I use my laptop.
lines.zh: : 福利镜头？您这话什么意思？我用笔记本电脑的时候就是这么站的。

lines.en: : Okay. As long as you’re not only doing it to try and increase the appeal of the game to people who don’t like to read.
lines.zh: : 好吧。只要你不是只为了吸引那些不爱看字的人，才去增加游戏的吸引力就行。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip24
: Because, as far as I’m concerned, fanservice is the worst possible way to do that. And I can tell you now that I won’t take any part in it.
lines.zh: : 因为在我看来，福利镜头是达到这个目的最烂的办法。我现在就可以告诉你，我不会掺和那种事。

lines.en: : Really? But aren’t we only going to the beach so you can do the photo-shoot for your swimsuit calendar?
lines.zh: : 真的吗？可我们去海边，不就是为了你拍泳装日历吗？

lines.en: : There’s a big difference between gravure photography and overly-gratuitous, weirdly angled upskirt shots. You’ll know what I mean one day, Ami. I’m sure.
lines.zh: : 写真摄影跟那种刻意卖弄、角度诡异的裙底偷拍，可是天差地别。总有一天你会明白我的意思的，Ami。我敢肯定。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip25
: Maybe. And yeah, I’m all packed. Can we really not bring Sensei, though?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。嗯，我收拾好了。不过我们真的不能带上 Sensei 吗？

lines.en: : You say that like he’s our dog.
lines.zh: : 你这语气，说得好像他是我们的狗一样。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip26
: That’d be nice...
lines.zh: : 那也挺好……

lines.en: : I can only be disappointed in myself for giving you the opportunity to say that.
lines.zh: : 我只能为自己给了你说这话的机会而失望。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip27
: But no — we can not bring your father. If you really want a dog, you have Noriko. That’s close enough.
lines.zh: : 但不行——我们不能带上你爸爸。你要是真想要条狗，你不是有 Noriko 吗。够接近了。

lines.en: : But I don’t want to sit on Noriko’s face.
lines.zh: : 可我不想坐在 Noriko 脸上。

lines.en: : I’m sure Noriko would be very upset to hear you say that.
lines.zh: : Noriko 听到你这么说，肯定很伤心。

lines.en: : You’ll be fine for two days without Akira, Ami. You’ve done it plenty of times before.
lines.zh: : 没有 Akira 你也能撑两天，Ami。你以前又不是没撑过。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip28
: Plus! This gives you and me more time to do girl stuff! And bond! And this time, we’ll have a {i}third{/i} player for Cards Against Humanity! That’s slightly less depressing!
lines.zh: : 而且！这样你我就有更多时间做女孩子的事了！还能增进感情！这次我们玩《反人类卡》还有{i}第三{/i}个人！那就没那么凄凉了！

lines.en: : Yeah...but every time you try to hang out with me, I always make it weird. And I’m tired of disappointing you...
lines.zh: : 嗯……可每次你想跟我玩，我都会把气氛搞得很怪。我也厌倦了让你失望……

lines.en: : You don’t disappoint me, Ami! You just gross me out. It’s different.
lines.zh: : 你没有让我失望，Ami！你只是让我觉得恶心。这不一样。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip29
: That’s even worse! I’d rather you just be disappointed in me. Or, ideally, just generally open to the idea of a father and daughter who sexually experiment together. Every day.
lines.zh: : 那更糟！我宁可你只是对我失望。或者最理想的情况是，你能普遍接受一对每天都一起做性探索的父女。

lines.en: : You’re doing it again.
lines.zh: : 你又来了。

lines.en: : But Aunt Niki! What if I never meet or even {i}encounter{/i} another boy?!
lines.zh: : 可是 Niki 阿姨！要是我永远都{i}遇不到{/i}别的男孩子呢？！

lines.en: : Will you really subject me to a life of forced abstinence when there’s a perfectly good dad right across the hall?
lines.zh: : 明明走廊对面就有个完好无损的爸爸，你真要逼我过一辈子禁欲的生活吗？

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: : 是的。

lines.en: scene nikipretrip30
: Now, that’s just mean. I bet you’d have sex with {i}your{/i} dad if he was the only guy around.
lines.zh: : 这就太过分了。我打赌，要是{i}你{/i}爸是身边唯一的男人，你也会跟他上床。

lines.en: : I am going to pretend you didn’t just say that. Now, go put your shit in the limo.
lines.zh: : 我就当你没说过这句话。现在，把你的东西搬进车里。

lines.en: : Can I maybe just...you know...{i}sample{/i} him? With your supervision?
